name: maybetoday
title: maybetoday
blurb: a daily oracle for whatever "it" is: type what you're hoping for (or leave it blank) and get today's odds — a percentage and a verdict, seeded from the date so asking twice today gives the same answer. it only changes its mind at midnight. @ver.ooo tagged the bot with just a mood — "maybe it will happen today" — so that's the whole site.
